sections.title: 6.1. Coronary Artery Disease
key_points: Research highlights trends in cardiovascular risk and disease prevalence in non-cardiac surgery patients.
Development and validation of risk calculators for predicting cardiac risk in surgical patients.
Comparison of revascularization strategies and management of coronary artery disease in surgical contexts.

sections.title: 6.2. Hypertension and Perioperative Blood Pressure
key_points: Investigation into the relationship between blood pressure management and postoperative outcomes.
Analyzing associations between preoperative hypertension and surgical risks.
